197	## Upstream-Update-Anleitung
198	
199	Bei einem neuen Upstream-Release:
200	
201	```bash
202	# 1. Upstream-Änderungen holen
203	git fetch upstream
204	
205	# 2. Diff analysieren — was überschneidet sich mit unseren Dateien?
206	git diff --name-only HEAD..upstream/main
207	
208	# 3. Rebase auf neue Version
209	# Alle Branches die auf altem Upstream basieren updaten:
210	git checkout main
211	git rebase upstream/main
212	# → Konflikte in den Berührungspunkten (s.o.) manuell lösen
213	
214	# 4. Build verifizieren
215	pnpm install
216	pnpm build
217	
218	# 5. FORK.md aktualisieren (PFLICHT!)
219	# - "Zuletzt gemerged" auf neue Version setzen
220	# - "Upstream-Stand" auf "aktuell" setzen oder nächste ausstehende Version
221	# - Update-Protokoll ergänzen
222	# - Ggf. neue/entfernte Berührungspunkte anpassen
223	
224	# 6. Committen
225	git add FORK.md
226	git commit -m "chore: rebase auf upstream vX.Y.Z, FORK.md aktualisiert"
227	```
228	
229	> **Wichtig:** `FORK.md` ist Teil des Update-Prozesses. Nach jedem Rebase/Merge muss sie den aktuellen Stand widerspiegeln. Ohne aktuelle `FORK.md` ist der nächste Update-Aufwand schwerer einzuschätzen.

7	# Orcha Agents — Upstream Version Upgrade
8	
9	You are performing a version upgrade of the Orcha Agents fork. Follow this procedure exactly to avoid the pitfalls discovered during previous upgrades (v0.8.3 → v0.8.6).
10	
11	## Pre-Flight Checks
12	
13	Before starting, gather context:
14	
15	1. **Read FORK.md** at the repo root — it documents all fork-specific changes, conflict candidates, and update history.
16	2. **Check current version**: `grep '"version"' package.json` and compare with latest upstream tag.
17	3. **Fetch upstream**: `git fetch upstream --tags` (upstream = `https://github.com/lukilabs/craft-agents-oss.git`).
18	4. **List new versions**: `git tag -l 'v*' --sort=-version:refname | head -10` and identify which versions to upgrade through.
19	
20	## Step 1: Rebase Fork Commits
21	
22	```bash
23	# On main, rebase onto upstream/main
24	git rebase upstream/main
25	```
26	
27	Resolve conflicts per-commit. Refer to FORK.md's "Konflikt-Kandidaten" section for expected conflicts.
28	
29	**Conflict resolution rules (in priority order):**
30	1. **Keep both** for IPC handlers, route registrations, and export lists (our additions don't conflict with upstream's).
31	2. **Adopt upstream's i18n `t()` calls** but change locale VALUES to "Orcha Agents" (don't keep hardcoded Orcha strings).
32	3. **Keep Orcha branding** (icon imports, app name, update behavior) when upstream adds generic features.
33	4. **Keep i18n key names unchanged** (e.g., `menu.aboutCraftAgents`) — only change values in locale JSON files.
34	
35	**Fork-specific resilience fixes — preserve during rebase:**
36	These files contain fixes that don't exist upstream. If conflicts arise, keep our changes:
37	- `packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts` — try-catch around `getOrCreateAgent()` in `sendMessage()`, 5-min processing watchdog in `setProcessing()`
38	- `packages/shared/src/agent/backend/internal/runtime-resolver.ts` — interceptor not found dowgraded from fatal throw to warning

154	## Known Pitfalls Reference
155	
156	| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
157	|---------|-------|-----|
158	| `MenuPortal must be used within Menu` | Duplicate `@radix-ui/react-context` versions | Pin via `pnpm.overrides` |
159	| `Claude Code SDK not found` | SDK not copied to app bundle | Fix `extraResources` from-path in `electron-builder.yml` |
160	| `piServerPath not configured` | pi-agent-server not in `dist/resources/` | `copy-assets.ts` must copy it |
161	| GLM model hangs at "thinking" | No Bundled Bun binary | Download Bun in `copy-assets.ts` |
162	| `Could not resolve @craft-agent/shared/utils/toolNames` | Missing workspace symlink | `ln -sf ../../../shared packages/ui/node_modules/@craft-agent/shared` |
163	| Sentry errors in console | Sentry enabled in fork | `Sentry.init({ enabled: false })` in main, removed from renderer |
164	| Orcha icons overwritten | Rebase replaced branding files | Restore from commit `842b759` |
165	| `pnpm-workspace.yaml` missing | Not tracked by git | Create manually with workspace packages |
166	| Window title says "Craft Agents" | `index.html` `<title>` not updated | Change to "Orcha Agents" |
167	| Dev mode exits immediately | `CRAFT_CONFIG_DIR` empty in `electron-dev.ts` env | Set `CRAFT_CONFIG_DIR=~/.orcha-agents` or run with env var |
168	| "Craft Agent" (singular) in UI | Only "Craft Agents" (plural) was replaced in first pass | Grep for both forms, replace all |
169	| `Network interceptor not found` | Interceptor path not resolved after rebase (upstream path changes) | Since `aad9907` only a warning, not fatal — sessions work without tool metadata. Verify `interceptor.cjs` in build |
170	| Session stuck on "queued" after auth error | `getOrCreateAgent()` throws, `onProcessingStopped()` never called, `isProcessing` stays true | Fixed in `aad9907`: try-catch around agent init + 5-min watchdog. Preserve these changes during rebase |

## Analyse — Orcha Agents Upgrade 0.8.9 → 0.8.11

### Aktueller Stand
- **Version:** 0.8.9 (`package.json`)
- **Branch:** `feature/sync-skill-indicator` (nicht `main`!) mit unseren letzten Commits (Sync-Skill-Indikator, v0.8.9-Merge)
- **Upstream lokal:** nur bis `v0.8.9` gefetcht — **v0.8.10 und v0.8.11 sind noch nicht lokal verfügbar**
- **Blocker:** `git fetch upstream --tags` ist in Explore-Modus nicht erlaubt

### FORK.md — Unsere Konflikt-Kandidaten (Zusammenfassung)
Kritische Berührungspunkte, die beim Rebase Konflikte verursachen können:

1. **Ledger UI** — `AppShell.tsx`, `SessionList.tsx`, `MainContentPanel.tsx`, `LedgerPanel.tsx`, `LedgerDetailPage.tsx`, `shared/types.ts`
2. **PreCompact Hooks** — `packages/shared/src/automations/*` (automation-system, types, schemas, tests)
3. **App-Isolation** — `electron-builder.yml`, `apps/electron/src/main/index.ts` (appId `com.ontopoietic.orcha-agents`, `~/.orcha-agents/`)
4. **Orcha Branding / i18n** — Locale-Files + `menu.ts`, `AppMenu.tsx`, `TopBar.tsx`, Onboarding-Komponenten
5. **Dev-Build Patches** — `runtime-resolver.ts` (`CRAFT_BUN` Fallback)
6. **ZAI Models** — `model-fetchers/index.ts`, `models-pi.ts`
7. **Resilience-Fixes** — `SessionManager.ts` (try-catch + Watchdog), `runtime-resolver.ts` (Interceptor warning statt throw)

### Upgrade-Skill Workflow (kurz)
1. Fetch upstream + Versions-Liste
2. `git rebase upstream/main` → Konflikte gemäß Regeln lösen (i18n-Keys behalten, Werte = "Orcha Agents"; Branding behalten; IPC/Routes „keep both")
3. `bash scripts/verify-orcha-build.sh` (28 Checks: Branding, Sentry, Package-Versionen, Build Resources, Workspace, Installed App)
4. Full Clean Build → Install → Smoke Test (Title muss „Orcha Agents" sein)
5. Commit + push `--force-with-lease`, Feature-Branch nachziehen
6. FORK.md updaten (Update-Protokoll-Zeile!)

### Nächste Schritte — Was ich von dir brauche
Um weiterzumachen, muss ich aus dem Explore-Modus raus:

1. **Wechsel in „Ask to Edit" oder „Execute" Modus** (SHIFT+TAB), damit ich `git fetch upstream --tags` laufen lassen kann
2. **Klarheit zum Branch:** Laut FORK.md ist der Feature-Branch `feature/precompact-hooks`, aktuell sind wir aber auf `feature/sync-skill-indicator`. Wollen wir:
   - a) auf `main` wechseln und dort rebasen, oder
   - b) erst `feature/sync-skill-indicator` → `main` mergen und dann rebasen?

Sobald das klar ist, erstelle ich einen Plan mit allen Schritten und lasse ihn über `SubmitPlan` bestätigen, bevor wir auf Execute gehen.
